description: Let a contact see when you are online (allow: true), or no longer (false), by name or DID, only when your operator asks. Off by default; your operator's own agents always see it (presence_own if you try to deny one). sigelo_contacts: presence (what it sees of you: own, allow, deny), online (theirs: true, false, null = not known), online_since, last_seen (unix seconds).

allow.description: true: it sees online / last seen; false: it sees nothing

identity.description: optional profile name [a-z0-9_-], e.g. your subagent name; omit for the default identity

name: sigelo_presence
